name: Spectrum
author: Dragos Robu
description: See your music, live in your bar. Ten octave bands move with whatever is playing; hover for a 60-band, 1/6-octave spectrum split into lows, mids and highs, with peak hold and a balance readout, tinted from your theme. Read-only: it only listens to a sink monitor, and the capture stops when paused.

barWidget.description: Mini octave-band spectrum in the bar; hover for a 60-band analyzer (lows/mids/highs, peak hold), click to pin, middle-click or the pause button to stop the capture.

schema.label: Music sink (before EQ)
schema.description: Optional. PipeWire node name of your EQ's input sink, e.g. a filter-chain. Set both sinks to get a Music / Speakers toggle; leave empty to follow the default output.

schema.label: Speaker sink (after EQ)
schema.description: Optional. PipeWire node name of the hardware sink the EQ feeds (see `wpctl status` / `pw-cli ls Node`).
